scope: Purposive primary-source case catalogue, NOT a representative census. Historical announcements are archetypes, not current venue measurements.

inje2025.verification: official indexed notice; direct fetch returned 502
inje2025.facts: 5 outlets across TWO FLOORS: floor1 two outlets/128 seats/2 kiosks, floor2 three outlets/217 seats/3 kiosks; term weekdays 08-19; vacation 09-15
inje2025.limits: Floors must not be summed as a single shared seating zone. Buffet differs from made-to-order. Not a staffing measurement.

tuk2025.facts: TIP basement foodcourt five corners, 600 seats
tuk2025.limits: No throughput, staffing, hours or kiosk count established.

nusdeck.limits: Stalls may include beverage vendors. No measured demand or staff.

kita2025.facts: LaLa Terrace Kita-Ayase foodcourt: 10 outlets, approximately 500 seats
kita2025.limits: 51 refers to whole complex and is excluded. Announcement, not longitudinal survey.

toyosu2020.limits: Includes drinks/dessert; historical configuration, not present-day inventory.

sajo2025.verification: operator-parent company release, full query URL checked
sajo2025.facts: Deogyusan foodcourt north/south 174/196 seats; Gochang 265/185; Korean/Western/ramen/udon categories
sajo2025.limits: 32/20 outlets are whole rest-stop food/retail totals, NOT foodcourt counters. Four categories do NOT establish four independent vendors.

sora2017.facts: Changi T2 SORA: six concepts, approximately 300 seats
sora2017.limits: Historical Japanese-food-hall archetype; no claim venue remains open or operates 24h.

sora2019.verification: ANA Trading company-issued primary release, full text
sora2019.limits: Historical landside foodhall, not current operation; same operator as T2 so not independent population sampling.

changi2026.facts: Transit foodcourts 24/7; flight-linked arrival waves, kiosks/QR, different dietary tenant mixes
changi2026.limits: Qualitative subtype evidence only. Cannot attach 24h to SORA as an observed joint record.

kumho2024.facts: Asan Spavis foodcourt 562 square metres, 300 seats
kumho2024.limits: Lobby snack120 seats is separate and excluded; vendor count unknown.

uworld2026.facts: Yeosu U-World foodcourt on floor5:540 seats; Korean/Chinese/snacks/burger/pizza; kiosk ordering and group pre-orders
uworld2026.limits: Cuisine list is NOT exact vendor count. Group buffet and reserved bulk orders not reproduced in this engine.

inspire2023.verification: company-issued press release distributed on Newswire
inspire2023.facts: Planned resort foodcourt approximately3500 square metres,1000 seats
inspire2023.limits: Planning announcement, NOT observed current operation; retained as planned large-leisure envelope only.

sejong2026.facts: Four cuisine categories with interpreted menu counts20/14/11/19;3500-6500KRW
sejong2026.limits: Category counts do not independently establish vendor counts, staffing or seating.

storage.facts: Home refrigeration <=4C: raw poultry/minced meat1-2days; intact fresh meat3-5days; many cooked foods3-4days
storage.limits: NOT Korean commercial shelf-life rules. Only motivates perishable short-life sensitivity; actual supplier labels and handling are required.

queue2005.verification: Winter Simulation Conference primary case study
queue2005.facts: One campus quick-service operation separates cashier/soup/sandwich staff; tested alternative staffing
queue2005.limits: No universal workers-per-vendor ratio; supports resource separation, not numerical range.

krei2024.verification: government-hosted KREI primary survey PDF,3196 establishments
krei2024.facts: PDFp132:overall mean10.9 operating hours;PDFp373:general restaurants mean3.46 monthly workers, revenue-size subgroup means1.88-7.09;PDFp494:ingredient purchase frequency daily15.4%,3-4/week42.0%,1-2/week29.4%,less frequent13.2%
krei2024.limits: NOT a foodcourt sample. Monthly headcount is NOT simultaneous cooks. Purchase frequency is NOT delivery lead time. Context and frequency-category sensitivity only; no foodcourt population inference.

range_status: All assumed_ranges are EXPLICIT ENGINEERING SENSITIVITY ENVELOPES, not empirically validated ranges. Model-only scaffold counts and ingredient types are not measurements. No foreign prices are converted into Korean prices. Case-paired vendors/seats are the only observed structural anchors, with missing fields separately marked.
